title: TOTALLY RECOMMENDED
text: Excellent visit with Eva, you get to know the heritage in a kind and very pleasant way. Going with doggies and having the route adapted for them is a super plus. RECOMMENDED.
author: Patri687

title: A walk through history in the best company.
text:
Visit very pleasant discovering history and peculiarities of the Albaicín by Eva, our guide and accompanied by our little dog.

We very much appreciate these initiatives that make it easier for dog owners to leisure, if only in more cities.
author: supombo

title: Great petfriendly visit
text: Oh, great. An amazing visit from my dog. A wonderful way to get to know the city. I wish this kind of activity was done in more cities
author: Lucosam

title: As always, great
text:
As always (this is not the first time I have visited with Balea Travel) the experience was great. In our case the visit was made as an activity more than a weekend of family reunion. Having the company of Eva and the explanations of Francisco de Paula was fantastic.
This is the first time I have made a cultural visit as part of a reunion weekend and the experience is recommended.
We don't take our dogs, so we'll repeat with them
author: pilarmH1834LR

title: Guided pet tours of the Albaicín: very interesting and fun.
text: As always, a magnificent experience. I have already made other visits with Balea, and the truth is that they guarantee a good experience. In addition to the sympathy and kindness, which are always appreciated, they are very attentive to the needs of each client and each pet. The pace of the visit is very calm so that we can enjoy every corner without hurry. author: Perridaje

title: Fantastic cultural and pet-friendly experience
text: A fantastic and very well organized experience. It is adapted so that dogs can rest from the walk, drink water and socialize among themselves. Eva has been a great guide that makes you immerse yourself in the history and culture of each place, explaining not only the historical data but why they happened, what were the customs and traditions of the time. We are definitely looking forward to repeating! Granada is not a shiny city for pet-friendly options, and Balea Travel has exceeded my expectations. My dog had a good time pipe and so did I! Thank you so much!!
author: cmballesta

title: Very interesting!
text:
The visit was beautiful. I've discovered a lot of curiosities I didn't know about the Albaicín.
The dogs have been fantastically well behaved and it has been very nice to be able to do the activity with them.
